name: ValidateConstraints
description: Check the constraints of the whole project, or of one direct instance of the scope concept.

configStructure.name: scope
configStructure.description: ROOT checks the whole project. Any other value is a meta concept, and the active node must be a direct instance of it. When empty, the scope stored with the constraints is used.

configStructure.name: text
configStructure.description: Constraint text to check. When empty, the constraints registry on the project root is used.
